content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are essential for digital sellers who wish to sidestep the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors. These gateways allow creators to accept cryptocurrency payments without requiring customer identification. This is crucial in regions where financial isolation is prevalent, enabling creators to sell digital products directly to consumers without the hassles of traditional banks or payment systems. With reduced fees and immediate payment verification, no-KYC gateways empower creators to retain more revenue and build sustainable businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture of a no-KYC payment gateway integrates several components designed to facilitate smooth transactions. At its core, these systems utilize blockchain technology for secure and transparent payment processing. Creators can host their digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, with a backend powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handles order management. This setup ensures immediate file delivery upon confirmed payment, providing an efficient shopping experience for customers while maintaining full data ownership for the creator.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are either unavailable or overly restrictive. Whether you are an ebook author in Nigeria, a course instructor in Kenya, or a software developer in Pakistan, this approach allows you to monetize your skills and products without sacrificing control over your revenue. By leveraging no-KYC payment gateways, these creators can operate independently, avoiding high fees and establishing a direct relationship with their customers.
Reduce your payment processing fees dramatically with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To implement a no-KYC payment gateway, you need several components that work harmoniously. Start with a hosting service like GitHub Pages to display your products, then integrate a backend solution with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage transactions and order fulfillment. Use NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions with a minimal fee of 0.5%, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. Together, these elements create a seamless ecosystem for selling digital products efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Begin by selecting a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages, to showcase your digital products. Next, integrate Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and connect it to NOWPayments for payment processing. Load your products into the system and configure your delivery method using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, ensure you have a clear customer communication channel to confirm purchases and deliver products instantly. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all the blueprints and templates needed to get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a no-KYC payment gateway that accepts cryptocurrencies. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments, you can process transactions with minimal fees and without customer identification requirements. This allows you to retain more of your earnings and maintain control over your sales process.
Empower your sales by retaining direct control over your customer relationships.

Creators seeking to expand their options for selling digital downloads can explore solutions like the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This package provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack. For more information on these products, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies for your sales. This provides flexibility in payment options for your customers.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

To ensure automatic delivery of your digital products, you can use tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage the process. This setup allows for instant file delivery upon payment confirmation.
